gbm_population_evidence.quote: Adult patients with a histological diagnosis of glioblastoma and confirmed IDH status.

candidate_evidence.quote: In this study, all patients in the intervention group (vaccine) who reach the fifth dose will be randomized to receive either pembrolizumab or a placebo as an addition to the experimental treatment regimen.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Currently undergoing standard-of-care treatment, which includes surgery, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Levels of Th1-pattern tumor-reactive T lymphocytes in peripheral blood.

role_evidence.quote: utilizing allogeneic dendritic cells derived from healthy donors fused with autologous tumor cells from patients

agents.drug_class_hint: allogeneic hybrid dendritic cell / autologous tumour cell fusion vaccine

role_evidence.quote: This group is receiving the dendritic cell vaccine combined with pembrolizumab.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: anti-PD1 checkpoint inhibitor that can sustainably enhance the anti-tumor immune response

source_quote.quote: Adult patients with a histological diagnosis of glioblastoma and confirmed IDH status.

coder_notes: The 'DC Vaccine + Pembrolizumab Arm' is registered as ACTIVE_COMPARATOR but is described as vaccine plus pembrolizumab (an experimental add-on). Pembrolizumab coded as the only investigational drug (vaccine is an excluded type), so experimental_monotherapy on the vaccine backbone; regimen combination because the experimental arm also contains the vaccine. IDH status is only required to be 'confirmed', no wildtype requirement stated. The placebo (Other: Placebo) is not listed as an agent. Th1 T-cell immune response in blood is not clearly linked to pembrolizumab specifically, hence target_engagement unclear. Standard-of-care chemotherapy is mentioned only as ongoing background, not listed.
